title: Displacement-Robust Representations for Landslide EWS (RMCL)
why_matters_this_phase: forecast-displacement is a first-class input uncertainty; LEWS must report skill under forecast error
actionable_takeaway: build displacement-invariance via contrastive rain-field perturbation; report EWS skill under forecast error not observed rainfall

title: CatBoost vs operational GOES-FDC wildfire detection
why_matters_this_phase: recent direct CR-02 instance: GBM beats operational product under cross-region test
actionable_takeaway: gradient-boosted radiance detector is mandatory baseline + can beat operational; seasonal/spatial coverage dominates false-alarm

title: VAND 4.0 application-driven hidden-test AD benchmark
why_matters_this_phase: model for honest deployment-driven eval; rare-event collapse + efficiency-first
actionable_takeaway: adopt hidden test + mandatory repro artifacts; efficiency a first-class metric; report rare-event perf separately; VLMs not drop-in

title: Survey: VAD via deep learning (human/vehicle/environment)
why_matters_this_phase: challenge taxonomy C1-C10 = WS4 failure-mode checklist
actionable_takeaway: adopt C1-C10 checklist; define hazard classes explicitly (C3); plan concept drift (C10); cross-scene test (C8) mandatory

title: PID-Expert online conformal prediction for time series
why_matters_this_phase: coverage worst right after abrupt shift = hazard onset window (CR-04)
actionable_takeaway: use expert-aggregated online conformal; expect+report local under-coverage at onset; pair with hard shield

title: Mechanistic analysis of adversarial fine-tuning of ViTs
why_matters_this_phase: corruption-robustness does NOT transfer across corruption classes
actionable_takeaway: do not assume augmentation generalizes to unseen field shifts; enumerate+test expected shifts; prefer conformal/OOD guards

title: Signal-Routed Temperature Scaling (small-budget calibration)
why_matters_this_phase: calibrator capacity is a finite-sample choice; our hazard-val sets are tiny
actionable_takeaway: use low-capacity risk-conditioned calibrator (K~3 groups) not scalar nor high-capacity; scale capacity to data

title: Evidential smoke-density classification + selective prediction
why_matters_this_phase: evidential vacuity = cheap false-alarm/abstention + image-quality gate
actionable_takeaway: evidential head + vacuity abstention as false-alarm control; report accuracy-vs-coverage; add cross-region test before trusting ECE

title: Survey: Evolution of VAD DNN→MLLM (unified framework)
actionable_takeaway: frame WS4 as anomaly grounding; reserve understanding for cloud tier; use optical-flow/skeleton inputs (cheap+robust+private)

title: Survey: UQ for trustworthy deep learning (methods+measures)
why_matters_this_phase: backbone reference for WS6 UQ method selection under compute limits
actionable_takeaway: Deep Ensemble reference on Kaggle; BatchEnsemble/last-layer-Bayes/MC-Dropout at edge; separate aleatoric/epistemic; log each method limitation

title: BanglaMM-Disaster multimodal social-media disaster classification
why_matters_this_phase: low-resource South-Asian multimodal; crowd-report layer is weak/biased input
actionable_takeaway: treat social-media as low-weight corroborating signal not standalone alarm; budget multilingual encoders; distrust recall during real events

title: Cross-architecture foundation-model distillation for edge flood segmentation
why_matters_this_phase: CR-02 3rd domain (flood): fixed MNDWI rule competitive w/ deep models; concrete Jetson edge profile
actionable_takeaway: distill GFM→sub-1M INT8 student (5.57ms Jetson); always include spectral-index baseline; fuse SAR for cloud; chip→map→event grouping vs leakage

title: Parser-free VLM verification for federated WSVAD
why_matters_this_phase: federated MIL + privacy; VLM text-gen verification is prompt-fragile
actionable_takeaway: federated MIL keeps raw video local (privacy); cheap-scorer→suspect-verifier cascade; use VLM logit not text-gen interface; 2B VLM is gateway tier not edge

title: Adaptive multi-granularity temporal modeling for WSVAD
why_matters_this_phase: hazards span seconds→hours; fixed snippet windows are a known weakness
actionable_takeaway: use adaptive event segmentation (variable duration) not fixed windows; still add cross-scene test; report cost-loss not just frame-AUC

title: IRENE ConvGRU ensemble radar precipitation nowcasting
why_matters_this_phase: probabilistic nowcasting + honest multi-metric eval; skill ceiling ~90min
actionable_takeaway: make precip nowcast probabilistic+ensemble; eval CRPS+rank-histogram+RAPSD not just MAE; importance-sample rare rain; honest short-horizon lead

title: HaorFloodAlert: operational free-data flash-flood EWS (Bangladesh haor)
